changelog:
Initial release — generates vocational education talent development plans for professional programs.

- Supports automatic collection of required standards and professional codes using built-in national datasets; user upload is optional for key documents.
- Integrates and merges data from teaching standards and occupational analysis reports to construct program content, curriculum, and course objectives.
- Offers built-in, education-level-specific templates (secondary/vocational/combined) for docx output, with the option for user-supplied format samples.
- Performs structured multi-phase data processing (retrieval, preprocessing, template analysis, standards extraction, occupation analysis, data synthesis, and chapter generation).
- Ensures compliance with national public course requirements and terminology using pre-loaded standards references.
- Guides users through multi-source data fusion with stepwise confirmation dialogs for key elements such as course structure and occupational targets.
